jyutping: ji3 si1 soeng1 tung4 ge3 ci4

english.note: Use this plain Cantonese description when explaining the idea instead of using the technical term 同義詞.

examples.english: These two words mean the same thing, so one is a synonym for the other.
examples.traditional: 呢兩個詞意思一樣，其中一個就係另一個嘅意思相同嘅詞。
examples.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 go3 ci4 ji3 si1 jat1 joeng6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 zau6 hai6 ling6 jat1 go3 ge3 ji3 si1 soeng1 tung4 ge3 ci4
